name: Inventory coverage
formula: agents with identity ∩ inventory ÷ agents with identity

name: Control-test coverage
formula: applicable controls with deterministic test ÷ applicable controls

name: Record completeness
formula: actions with chain-verified 07 and all grounds fields ÷ actions (worst day)

name: Gateway bypass attempts
formula: calls reaching core systems not via gateway

name: Gate block rate
formula: proposed actions blocked ÷ proposed, by reason

name: Escalation rate
formula: cases escalated ÷ cases, by type, with tail

name: Override rate
formula: human reversals of agent closures where a human looked, by reviewer, with tail

name: Time to halt
formula: minutes from kill-switch decision to zero actions, last drill

name: Change-to-revalidation
formula: days from material change to completed full 09 round

name: Disagreement rate
formula: agent-wrong disagreements ÷ n, Wilson 95%, overall + worst stratum

name: Calibration status
formula: per band: calibrated / not / void, with rounds held

name: Canary catch rate
formula: seeded known-wrong outputs caught by on-the-loop operators ÷ seeded

name: Outcome coverage
formula: closures in strata with no 09 sample this quarter ÷ closures, strata named
